items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: In 1926 in New York you recorded with Perry Bradford's Mean Four... 'Heebie-Jeebies,' yeah, I remember that.

ctx.x: Oh, you have those? I see. But I was going to ask you about the other day when we were talking about recordings -- we're skipping around, probably going to drive the people crazy listening to this tape, but it can't be helped.
In 1926 in New York you recorded with Perry Bradford's Mean Four, "Don't Forget To Mess Around" and "Heebie-Jeebies."
